headlines.text: On a Friday in 2022, back when Buddy Matthews stepped back through the curtain after just under 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Dustin Rhodes went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.36.
